We missed you at our Transforming Patient Payments for a Smoother Financial Experience <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-transforming-patient-payments-for-a-smoother-financial-experience?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=]]> webinar!
In this session, OrthoNebraska's Manager of Patient Financial Services, Kara Albright, shares insights from their recent billing and payments transformation including how they streamlined payment processes, enhanced patient experiences and boosted their financial results.
Here is the link to the webinar recording <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-transforming-patient-payments-for-a-smoother-financial-experience?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=]]>.
Have questions? If you are a Flywire client, please reach out to your Client Success Manager.
If you’d like a demo <[[https://more.flywire.com/Healthcare_Demo_Generic_Marketo.html?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=]]> to see how we can help you create an "Amazon-like" experience for your patients today, just let us know.
Have a great day! Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
